lines.en: Weaves webs in darkness to catch prey.
Eight legs cross the purple-black sand.

lines.zh: 我在末地石上留下一串足迹。
lines.en: I leave a trail of prints on the end stone.

lines.zh: 我沿着裂缝爬，避开空旷。
lines.en: I crawl along cracks, avoiding open ground.

lines.zh: 末影碎片在我腹下轻响。
lines.en: Ender shards click beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 我停下来，触须先探出去。
lines.en: I halt and test the way with my feelers.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，身子几乎平了。
lines.en: I keep to the wall, my body nearly flat.

lines.zh: 我挂在岩壁上，腿收成一团。
lines.en: I hang on the rock, legs drawn in.
I draw my legs in and hang on the rock.

lines.zh: 我把丝线绕在脚上，慢慢拉。
lines.en: I wind silk around my leg and pull it slowly.

lines.zh: 八只眼把你的影子量了一遍。
末影碎片在我背上发亮。
lines.en: Ender shards glint on my back.

lines.zh: 末影碎片从我身上掉了一地。
我的腿蜷起来，丝也断了。
lines.en: My legs curl up and my silk snaps.
One front leg snapped; I can still crawl.

lines.zh: 你那美味的果实，正好入我口!
lines.en: Your sweet fruit is just what I crave.

lines.zh: 你的身影如此诱人，让我忍不住想要尝试!
lines.en: Your form is so alluring, I can't resist trying you.

lines.zh: 尝尝我的毒液，看看你会不会倒下!
lines.en: Taste my venom, and see if you fall.

lines.zh: 你是末地的美味，为何不成为我的猎物?
lines.en: You're a delicacy of the End, why not become my prey?

lines.zh: 你的香气引导我来到这里，快让我享用!
lines.en: Your scent led me here, come and be devoured.

lines.zh: 你那鲜艳的外表，吸引着我的猎心!
lines.en: Your bright appearance draws my hunter's eye.

lines.zh: 你为何还在这？我的猎物已经准备好了!
lines.en: Why are you still here? My prey is ready.

lines.zh: 这果实如此诱人，你难道不想试试吗?
lines.en: Such a tempting fruit, do you not want to try it?

lines.zh: 不要靠近，否则你会后悔!
lines.en: Stay back, or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 小心我的毒刺，它们很致命!
我们之间只有死亡的距离!
lines.en: Death is the only distance between us.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我的领域，现在受死吧!
lines.en: You trespassed in my domain, now die.

lines.zh: 我的毒液足以结束你的生命!
lines.en: My venom will end your life.

lines.zh: 别来惹我，否则你会遭殃!
lines.en: Don't provoke me, or you'll suffer.

lines.zh: 你的速度不够快，逃不过我的毒液!
lines.en: Your speed isn't fast enough to escape my venom.

lines.zh: 我只需轻轻一击，你就会倒下!
lines.en: A mere touch from me will send you down.

lines.zh: 我的毒液是致命的，你无法逃脱!
lines.en: My venom is lethal, you can't escape.
Finding a mate is my purpose.

lines.zh: 我的毒液可以保护后代!
与我交配，你将拥有我的力量!
lines.en: Mate with me, and gain my strength.

lines.zh: 交配可以增强我们的基因!
我的毒液能确保我们的后代安全!
lines.en: My venom ensures our young are safe.

lines.zh: 交配后，你会得到我的守护!
lines.en: After mating, you'll be protected by me.

lines.zh: 与我交配，让我们共同繁衍!
lines.en: Mate with me, and let us reproduce together.

lines.zh: 交配可以让我们更加强大!
这块碎片黏在我丝上，归我。
lines.en: This shard stuck to my silk — mine.
I am part of the Ender!

lines.zh: 末影的缝里，我盯住你了。
lines.en: From the End's seam, I have you in sight.
Gift from the End! — 末影蜘蛛, target acquire

lines.zh: 末影碎片在我腿上闪着紫光。
lines.en: Ender shards glint purple on my legs.
Ender shards click between my legs.

lines.zh: 地面微微一颤，我知道你来了。
lines.en: The ground trembles slightly. I know you're here.
My two front legs lift, pointing at you.
Ender shards are woven into me.

lines.zh: 不要让毒液进入你体内！
lines.en: Don't let the venom enter your body!

lines.zh: 前足抬起，丝囊已经鼓了。
lines.en: Front legs raised, my silk sac already full.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶织了一张网。
lines.en: I have spun a web above your head.

lines.zh: 丝线已经黏在你的靴底。
lines.en: Silk already clings to your boot soles.

lines.zh: 末影碎片在我腿边噼啪响。
lines.en: Ender fragments crackle at my legs.

lines.zh: 紫沙一响，我从缝里爬出。
lines.en: The purple sand shifts; I climb out of a crack.

lines.zh: 末影碎片在我身上，来拿。
lines.en: Ender shards cling to me. Come take them.

lines.zh: 紫色的光一闪，我在这里。
lines.en: A flash of purple, and here I am.

lines.zh: 主世界很少见到我，记住这天。
lines.en: You rarely see me in the Overworld. Remember this day.
One lick of flame and my silk curls.

lines.zh: 从岩壁掉下，腿折了两条。
lines.en: I fell from the wall and bent two legs.

lines.zh: 箭插在腿上，末影碎片还在。
lines.en: Arrow in my leg. My shards are intact.
Empty belly makes my silk come thin.

lines.zh: 末影的味道，被雷打散了。
lines.en: Lightning scatters the ender scent off me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有末地石，只剩紫黑。
lines.en: No end stone below — only purple dark.
